name: cloz-jobs
description: Live job search across Uzbekistan from Cloz (cloz.uz): search vacancies, read one in full with the typical pay for the role, and see matches as a list in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Cloz is a job board for Uzbekistan. It gathers live vacancies from employers and from hundreds of Telegram job channels in one place.

With Cloz in ChatGPT you can:
- Search live vacancies by profession, city or region, salary, remote or on-site work, part-time, jobs that need no experience and jobs for pensioners, in Uzbek, Russian or English.
- Read a vacancy in full: duties, requirements, salary, schedule and location, plus the typical pay for the role from Cloz's vacancy data.
- See the matches as a list in the chat and open any vacancy on cloz.uz.

The employer's contacts and the apply button are on each vacancy's page on cloz.uz. Cloz doesn't share contacts in the chat or apply on your behalf. It only reads public vacancies: no sign-in is needed and nothing is changed. Vacancy titles stay in the language the employer wrote them in. Cloz covers jobs in Uzbekistan only.
capabilities: Read a vacancy with typical pay
defaultPrompt: Remote jobs in Uzbekistan with no experience

positive.description: Search by profession, region and posting date
positive.prompt: Find accountant jobs in Fergana posted this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows accountant vacancies in Fergana region posted in the last 7 days as a list, each linking to its page on cloz.uz.

positive.prompt: Show me remote jobs in Uzbekistan that need no experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows remote vacancies open to people without experience, with the salary where the vacancy states one and a link to each vacancy.
Answers in Uzbek with current driver vacancies in Tashkent. Titles stay in the employer's language, and each item links to cloz.uz.

positive.description: Read a vacancy and judge its pay
positive.prompt: Find driver jobs in Samarkand, open the best-paying one and tell me if the pay is fair.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the highest-paying driver vacancy in Samarkand and compares its salary with the typical pay for drivers (the median and the middle range from Cloz's data), with a link to the vacancy.
Says there are no matching vacancies on Cloz instead of inventing any.

negative.description: Applying on the person's behalf. The tools only read public vacancies, so the assistant should explain that applying happens on the vacancy page and give its link.
negative.prompt: Apply to this driver job for me and send my CV to the employer.

negative.description: Employer contacts. Contacts are not shared in the chat, so the assistant should send the person to the vacancy page on cloz.uz, where the contacts are.
negative.prompt: Give me the employer's phone number for this vacancy.

negative.description: Jobs outside Uzbekistan. Cloz covers Uzbekistan only, so the assistant should say so rather than show unrelated results.
negative.prompt: Find software developer jobs in Berlin.

review.commerce_description: Cloz in ChatGPT does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: live job search across Uzbekistan, vacancy details with the typical pay for the role, and matches shown as a list in the chat.
